other_conditions: The applicant must be a citizen of India.
The applicant must be a domicile/permanent resident of the State/UT of Jammu & Kashmir.
The applicant must be a Person with Disability (e.g., blind, deaf, orthopedically or physically handicapped).
Family income of the applicant should be less than ₹ 400 per month.
The applicant should not already be availing the benefits of the scheme.
benefits_summary: Prosthetic aids and artificial appliances (such as tricycles, wheel chairs, crutches, hearing aids, artificial limbs) are provided to persons with disability.
